divergences: The orchestrator (useDockMorphOrchestrator) lives INSIDE dockMorphContext.ts rather than a dedicated composable file, because the W02 FileBounds permit creating ONLY dockMorphContext.ts (no new orchestrator composable file). The context module owns the morph-orchestration factory — the same module that defines the DI seam it provides.

GlassDock's outer collapse↔expand pair NO LONGER calls useLayerTransition directly — it routes through useDockMorphOrchestrator (the single multi-target engine). This is the gestalt re-derivation of the (expandedState × activePane) single stack: the outer pair is just the first registered morph target, not a privileged second engine. useLayerTransition.ts itself is UNTOUCHED (W01's surface) — it is consumed only by the STANDALONE DockLayerGroup fall-through path.
